label: We Work Remotely
terms_note: Public RSS feeds per category; no key; no published limit.

auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: title, link, region, category, description, pubDate

reference.limits: - Public RSS; terms opened, no feed / robot clause surfaced.

adapter.terms: We Work Remotely public RSS. Applications go through each listing's page.

search_postings.note: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (all current remote jobs, RSS 2.0, ~80 items and ~800 KB); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). These are employment listings: title is '<company>: <job title>'; region, country, skills (comma-separated text), category, type and expires_at stay in raw; description is HTML. Per-category feeds (/categories/<slug>.rss) exist but are not selectable here.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint; each posting's page (url) is HTML only. search_postings returns the whole record.
not_offered.submit_bid: Applications go through the listing page on weworkremotely.com; there is no application API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
